_doc: Group towns3 (Fallarbor, Lavaridge, Fortree): building models in exterior pack 0, res range 360-379 (format: data/buildings/slice.json). Models are made by b2tools/models_fallarbor.py, models_lavaridge.py, models_fortree.py (notes/TOWNS_TOWNS3.md). Pokemon Centers/Marts use the shared res 0/3, gyms the shared res 320 (group towns1). door 65535 = no door model (Black 2's own door-less records: door 0xFFFF, offsets 0). dx: the door models 164/165/236/260 span x -17..1 (236: -18..2) around their origin (hinge at the right edge), door01 (101) x -20..0, door_pc (93) x -13..13 (apicula conversion of pack 0's door models); Black 2 places the hinge so the door is centred on the warp tile (Nuvema chunk 0: house res 5 at x 783.0, its warp at tile 782), so dx = door tile centre - footprint centre + 8 (+10 for door 101, +0 for door 93). Door dz: the door model's glass (door 165/236 at z 0, 164 at -1) and plate (+2) must stay 1 unit or more off the wall and frame planes they overlap (melonDS flicker); dz was moved forward where b2tools/exterior_check.py found them closer (exterior sweep 2026-10-06).
